title: INT ( -4.3 ) is -5: INT rounds down, unlike CONVERT

source.quote: TRUNC(-4.3) returns -4, but INT(-4.3) returns -5 because -5 is the lower number
If <Number> is an Integer or a Decimal data type data type, then the result is an Integer data type
source.supports: INT of a decimal number is an integer

notes: Contrast for CONVERT: CONVERT ( -4.3, INTEGER ) would be -4.
